_comment: Tier-2 for febio::polar_fluid#0. Three name observations: <var type="micro_rotation"/> reads SUCCESS and then aborts with 'FATAL ERROR: Output variable "micro_rotation" is not defined'; <bc type="zero micro-rotation"> is a parse error; and the micro-rotation DOFs cannot be logged at all — <node_data data="gvx"/> is refused with '"gvx" is not a valid field variable name', so "read the field" means reading the .xplt, not a CSV. Plus the measured caveat: deleting the wall BC moves the logged element data by far less than a solution change would, so a quiet result is not evidence the BC is right. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
